secondary_reward_comparison: within categorical policy, active minus total at original reward units and original inputs; descriptive only, cannot replace primary gate
control: frozen total continuous PPO update 2, same fold, seed and band
inference: argmax logits, first index on tie
gate: 2 lot: >=4/6 paired improvements at 8 decimals and positive median improvement; 1 lot: nonnegative median improvement. Also require positive median absolute net excess vs zero at 2 lot before expanding.
